name: Saga's Chicago study 1 reported a year-two bound of 0.305 study-sample standard deviations for CPS math test (study sample Z), assuming only first-year benefits persist.
description: Table 6, p. 753 reports 0.305 (SE 0.067; N=1640; FDR q=0.001). This bound assumes nonnegative benefits and zero incremental second-year benefit; it is not a point effect or confidence limit.
